# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def contention_cost(utilization: float) -> float:
    cost = utilization * utilization / max(1.0 - utilization, 0.02)
    if utilization > 0.55:
        cost = cost + 3.0 * (utilization - 0.55)
    if utilization > 0.75:
        cost = cost + 10.0 * (utilization - 0.75)
    if utilization > 0.90:
        cost = cost + 30.0 * (utilization - 0.90)
    return cost

def node_pressure(cpu: float, mem: float) -> float:
    cpu_cost = contention_cost(cpu)
    mem_cost = contention_cost(mem)
    return max(cpu_cost, 0.85 * mem_cost) + 0.10 * min(cpu_cost, mem_cost)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0

    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_before = float(node.cpu_allocated) / cpu_cap
    mem_before = float(node.mem_allocated) / mem_cap
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    pressure = node_pressure(cpu_after, mem_after)
    previous_pressure = node_pressure(cpu_before, mem_before)
    pressure_increase = max(pressure - previous_pressure, 0.0)

    incoming_latency = 0.0
    incoming_rate = 0.0
    outgoing_latency = 0.0
    outgoing_rate = 0.0
    incoming_worst = 0.0
    outgoing_worst = 0.0
    incoming_queue = 0.0
    outgoing_queue = 0.0
    incoming_queue_worst = 0.0
    outgoing_queue_worst = 0.0
    incoming_path_worst = 0.0
    outgoing_path_worst = 0.0
    dependency_pressure = 0.0
    delay_pressure = 0.0
    local_rate = 0.0
    total_payload = 0.0
    remote_payload = 0.0
    affected_rate = 0.0
    affected_path_worst = 0.0

    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
        other = -1
        outgoing = False
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
            outgoing = True
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source

        if rate > 0.0 and source != pod.id and destination != pod.id:
            source_node = ctx.pods[source].current_node
            destination_node = ctx.pods[destination].current_node
            if source_node == node.id or destination_node == node.id:
                affected_rate = affected_rate + rate
                affected_latency = 0.0
                if source_node >= 0 and destination_node >= 0 and source_node != destination_node:
                    affected_latency = ctx.nodes[source_node].latency_to_ms[destination_node]
                affected_path = pressure_increase * (0.10 + affected_latency / 100.0)
                affected_path_worst = max(affected_path_worst, affected_path)

        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and rate > 0.0:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                neighbor_node = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node]
                latency = 0.0
                if neighbor.current_node != node.id and outgoing:
                    latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                elif neighbor.current_node != node.id:
                    latency = neighbor_node.latency_to_ms[node.id]

                neighbor_cpu = float(neighbor_node.cpu_allocated) / float(max(neighbor_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
                neighbor_mem = float(neighbor_node.mem_allocated) / float(max(neighbor_node.mem_capacity, 1))
                neighbor_cost = node_pressure(neighbor_cpu, neighbor_mem)
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    neighbor_cost = pressure
                    local_rate = local_rate + rate

                dependency_pressure = dependency_pressure + rate * neighbor_cost
                delay_pressure = delay_pressure + rate * latency * neighbor_cost
                payload = rate * ctx.graph.payload_kb[e]
                total_payload = total_payload + payload
                if neighbor.current_node != node.id:
                    remote_payload = remote_payload + payload

                # Keep low-rate edges visible in the critical-path estimate.
                edge_path = latency / 35.0
                edge_path = edge_path * (1.0 + 0.40 * pressure + 0.20 * neighbor_cost)
                edge_path = edge_path + 0.12 * neighbor_cost
                if outgoing:
                    outgoing_latency = outgoing_latency + rate * latency
                    outgoing_rate = outgoing_rate + rate
                    outgoing_worst = max(outgoing_worst, latency)
                    outgoing_queue = outgoing_queue + rate * neighbor_cost
                    outgoing_queue_worst = max(outgoing_queue_worst, neighbor_cost)
                    outgoing_path_worst = max(outgoing_path_worst, edge_path)
                else:
                    incoming_latency = incoming_latency + rate * latency
                    incoming_rate = incoming_rate + rate
                    incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)
                    incoming_queue = incoming_queue + rate * neighbor_cost
                    incoming_queue_worst = max(incoming_queue_worst, neighbor_cost)
                    incoming_path_worst = max(incoming_path_worst, edge_path)

    incoming_mean = 0.0
    outgoing_mean = 0.0
    incoming_queue_mean = 0.0
    outgoing_queue_mean = 0.0
    if incoming_rate > 0.0:
        incoming_mean = incoming_latency / incoming_rate
        incoming_queue_mean = incoming_queue / incoming_rate
    if outgoing_rate > 0.0:
        outgoing_mean = outgoing_latency / outgoing_rate
        outgoing_queue_mean = outgoing_queue / outgoing_rate

    total_rate = incoming_rate + outgoing_rate
    network_cost = 0.0
    dependency_cost = 0.0
    remote_queue_cost = 0.0
    local_fraction = 0.0
    affected_fraction = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        network_cost = (incoming_mean + outgoing_mean) / 40.0
        network_cost = network_cost + (incoming_worst + outgoing_worst) / 65.0
        dependency_cost = dependency_pressure / total_rate
        remote_queue_cost = delay_pressure / total_rate / 55.0
        local_fraction = local_rate / total_rate
        affected_fraction = min(affected_rate / total_rate, 3.0)
    elif affected_rate > 0.0:
        affected_fraction = 1.0

    path_queue = incoming_queue_mean + outgoing_queue_mean
    path_queue = path_queue + 0.30 * (incoming_queue_worst + outgoing_queue_worst)
    deadline_cost = network_cost * (1.0 + 0.40 * pressure)
    deadline_cost = deadline_cost + 0.25 * remote_queue_cost
    deadline_cost = deadline_cost + 0.10 * path_queue
    critical_path = incoming_path_worst + outgoing_path_worst
    deadline_cost = deadline_cost + 0.45 * critical_path

    # Protect existing traffic as well as the newly placed pod.
    shared_pressure = pressure_increase * max(cpu_before, mem_before)
    shared_pressure = shared_pressure * (1.0 + local_fraction + 0.50 * affected_fraction)
    shared_pressure = shared_pressure + affected_path_worst

    dynamic_range = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = dynamic_range * float(pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0 and node.suspendable:
        incremental_power = incremental_power + node.power_idle_w
    energy_cost = incremental_power / 120.0

    remote_fraction = 0.0
    if total_payload > 0.0:
        remote_fraction = remote_payload / total_payload

    # Energy preference fades rapidly when path or queue headroom shrinks.
    path_excess = max(critical_path - 1.0, 0.0)
    pressure_excess = max(pressure - 1.5, 0.0)
    risk_cost = 0.18 * path_excess * path_excess
    risk_cost = risk_cost + 0.12 * pressure_excess * pressure_excess
    energy_weight = 0.16 / (1.0 + pressure + deadline_cost * deadline_cost + shared_pressure)
    cost = (
        0.50 * pressure
        + 0.70 * deadline_cost
        + 0.04 * dependency_cost
        + 0.14 * shared_pressure
        + risk_cost
        + energy_weight * energy_cost
        + 0.015 * remote_fraction
    )
    return -cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    # Remaining cumulative migration, byte, and unavailability allowances
    # are not observable. Zero moves preserves them across all windows.
    return out
